PC: Obtain a STAT calcium or ionized calcium level shortly after recognizing hydrofluoric acid exposure
Place the patient on telemetry and obtain an EKG
Rapidly administer IV calcium gluconate or chloride (antidote) after diagnosis of systemic hydrofluoric acid toxicity
Aggressively control pain with IV opioid analgesia
Prepare and administer topical calcium gel to topical burns
SBP: Consult burn surgeon for severe chemical burn
Transfer the patient to a Burn ICU
